attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Moving sanitize_html/supported_cultures filter registration into the always-loaded core service means these filters are now globally available even when the OrchardCore.Html/Localization features (and their required dependent services) aren't enabled, which could cause runtime DI failures for tenants using those filters without the corresponding feature turned on."}

reason: Moving sanitize_html/supported_cultures filter registration into the always-loaded core service means these filters are now globally available even when the OrchardCore.Html/Localization features (and their required dependent services) aren't enabled, which could cause runtime DI failures for tenants using those filters without the corresponding feature turned on.
